subject: Re: Offer letter language & headcount sign-off — Elena Ramos
message_1_subject: Final questions on offer — start date flexibility & relocation
message_1_body:
Hi Jonas and team,

Thanks again for the offer. I read through the draft and have a couple quick clarifications before I sign: 

1) Start date: I currently have a two-week notice window but an ongoing visa step that might push my availability by 2–3 weeks. Is a target start window (e.g., Oct 25 – Nov 8) acceptable? Are there onboarding steps that require an exact firm date for payroll/benefits?

2) Sign-on payment and recoupment: The offer lists a $12,000 sign-on bonus paid in lump sum. I want to confirm the recoupment language if I depart within the first year. Would Redwood consider: payment in two tranches (50% at start, 50% after 6 months) or a 12-month prorated recoupment rather than full repayment?

3) Relocation / stipend timing: The draft references a relocation stipend subject to receipts — is that reimbursed after a month on payroll or handled through payroll clawback mechanics?

I'm attaching my updated resume in case you need it. Happy to hop on a 15-minute call.

Best,
Elena Ramos
Product Engineer (incoming)
elena.ramos@gmail.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Elena_Ramos_resume.pdf (PDF, 220KB)
message_2_subject: Fwd: Final questions on offer — start date flexibility & recoupment proposal
message_2_body:
Folks — forwarding Elena's quick notes. TL;DR: candidate requests flexible start window, prefers split sign-on or prorated recoupment, and clarification on relocation reimbursement timing.

Proposals for redline: 
- Start window: allow 'target start between Oct 25 and Nov 8; final start date subject to mutual agreement and completion of I-9 and background checks.' That avoids repeating an exact date for payroll purposes but gives candidate certainty.

- Sign-on: change to 50/50 (50% on first paycheck after start; 50% after 6 months). Add recoupment language prorated over 12 months (if they leave before 12 months, repay prorated portion).

- Relocation: reimbursement after submission of receipts and completion of first 30 days on payroll; no upfront stipend unless invoices are pre-approved.

Marissa — do these align with comp band/finance constraints? Dev — please confirm headcount code and whether we can approve split payment (finance prefers 2-tranche for new hires). Laura — legal, can you run quick redline on the recoupment wording to avoid being overly broad (we want prorated and limited to sign-on + relocation reimbursements only).

I've attached the current offer draft (offer_draft_v3.pdf) and a quick doc with suggested tracked changes. If we can sign off today, I'll respond to Elena with proposed language and a DocuSign link.

— Jonas
Director, Product Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: offer_draft_v3.pdf, redlines_recapture_clause.docx
message_3_subject: Re: Fwd: Final questions on offer — headcount HCAP-1223 & redlines
message_3_body:
Jonas / Dev —

Thanks. Headcount HCAP-1223 is provisionally approved for Product Eng (opens in HR system: https://hr.redwood.example.com/headcount/HCAP-1223). Salary band check: the proposed base ($165,000) sits at the low-mid of Band PE3 — we can authorize up to $175k with manager approval. Sign-on policy: finance will accept split payments 50/50; must be coded to sign-on ledger and expense type 'NewHire_SignOn'.

I've reviewed the attached draft and made two quick redline suggestions in redlines_recapture_clause.docx (summary below):
- Recoupment window explicitly limited to sign-on and relocation reimbursements — exclude stock/equity.
- Proration: "If the employee voluntarily terminates or is terminated for cause within 12 months of the start date, the employee will repay the unearned portion of the sign-on and relocation reimbursement on a prorated basis."
- Add an examples appendix: shows repayment amounts at 0–6 months and 6–12 months.

We also need manager confirmation that a split payment is acceptable politically; Dev, please confirm manager-level sign-off on $12k sign-on (or propose $10k if we prefer to keep cash lower).

I can update the offer template and prepare a DocuSign packet once legal signs off.

— Marissa
Sr. Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.example.com

Attachment referenced: redlines_recapture_clause.docx
message_4_subject: Re: Offer language & HCAP-1223 approval — final OK
message_4_body:
Team — approved. Manager sign-off confirmed: $12,000 sign-on, split 50/50; start window Oct 25–Nov 8 is fine. Headcount HCAP-1223 confirmed and budgeted to Q4 hiring plan.

Laura — please proceed with narrow recoupment language as Marissa suggested (prorated over 12 months, sign-on + relocation only). Once legal returns redline, Marissa please prepare the DocuSign and we'll aim to send to Elena today.

Jonas — when you reply to Elena, please propose the two-tranche payment schedule and the tentative start window; also ask whether she needs an immigration payor note (if visa steps require additional paperwork).

Thanks — Dev
VP, Engineering Operations
dev_patel@redwood.example.com
